description:
The Sanitas Node Gravel is engineered for riders who demand uncompromising performance across every surface. The Node Gravel represents the pinnacle of modern gravel design. Crafted from aerospace-grade titanium, which delivers an exceptional balance of strength, lightweight efficiency, and lifelong durability, making it a true investment for serious cyclists.

Designed with progressive geometry, the bike offers a responsive yet stable ride—perfect for long-distance endurance, technical gravel routes, and fast-paced mixed-terrain racing. With generous 700×50mm tire clearance, it adapts effortlessly from smooth tarmac to rugged backcountry trails, providing superior traction and control in all conditions.

At the heart of the build is a meticulously engineered frame, utilizing a hand-selected 3AL/2.5V titanium tube set. The result is a ride quality that absorbs vibration while maintaining precise power transfer—delivering a comfortable ride and ensuring confident handling wherever your ride takes you. Internal cable routing and refined frame shaping create a clean aesthetic that matches its high-performance capabilities.

Whether you're racing gravel events or exploring roads less traveled, the Node Gravel is built to go further, faster, and longer—without limits.

Each frame is designed and built one by one in our Durango, Colorado, facility to provide a ride that’s specifically catered to the customer’s riding style and needs in mind.

The customization does not stop with your frame geometry or finish! Drivetrain and components are just as personal as your riding style! With the ability to hand-select the components of your choice, you have 100% say in building out the bike of your dreams. Complete bike builds are quoted upon request and individualized for each rider.
